title: Global script state (draft-duel onSave payload)
description: What table.lua's onSave returns and onLoad restores. Every key must have a default in onLoad, because older saves won't have newer keys. Add a key here in the same change that adds it to onSave.

draft.description: DraftCore:serialize() — pack, picks per color, starter, counters.

discard.description: GUID of the face-up discard pile.

bots.description: Seat colors a bot drafts for.

booster.description: Open Booster Tutor booster: opener color + card GUIDs.

owned.description: color -> { main = [guid], side = [guid] }, recorded at readyUp.

tutored.description: GUIDs taken with Booster Tutor this game.

mats.description: color -> { name, guid } of the seat's playmat tile.

cubeKey.description: Key of the cube on the table (an entry of CUBES_JSON).

cubeGuid.description: GUID of the cube deck; c00001 until players switch cubes.

boards.description: color -> GUID of the seat's zone board (from Ready until Next game).
